items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1958-07-00
items.q: Bob used to run it, you know. Bob, you know, would get loaded, you know. ... Bob wanted that money. I said, uh uh. I'm gonna beat bass drumming too.

ctx.x: I was interested in what you were saying there last night about, you played in the band for Huey Long from the train to the hall. Oh, man. Good kick out of that. To the hall.

You paraded him right in there. Oh, yeah. I was connected then around. I was going around. Hey, Paul, this is Bob, you know. Old Bob is the light. They thought there was an old Bob. You know, bottom line. They made me play an avatone.
Well, what instrument did you play in that band, that C band? What? What instrument? For Huey Long's that race.
